scope: Preregistered finite-policy input robustness, canonical fixed engine RNG, two aim-jitter streams per policy. Synthetic declared entry budgets. Not human probability, not independent random-engine draws. Unfinished at bound is not death. Successful-round statistics are conditional on success. Original clearRate denotes finite registered policy trial ratio, not human population rate. Policies are reported separately; no iid pooling or inferential binomial CI. Eventual completion bounds retain unfinished uncertainty.
